Remark
[Orthogonality characterization of constant curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0122 ↗ def:pet-ch3-constant-curvature

1. ch3:3.4.10Show that $(M,g)$ has constant curvature at $p$ iff $R(v,w)z=0$ for all pairwise orthogonal $v,w,z\in T_pM$. Hint: a symmetric bilinear form $B$ on an inner product space with $B(v,w)=0$ whenever $v\perp w$ is a multiple of the inner product.
